subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Reverse Logistics for Recycling
description: One-minute skill: Reverse Logistics for Recycling.

hook.text: Apple recovers gold, cobalt, and rare earths from old iPhones using a disassembly robot named Daisy.

buildup.text: Reverse logistics moves used products back through the chain for recycling, material recovery, or reuse.

discovery.text: Recovering materials from old products reduces the need for virgin extraction and cuts supply chain emissions.

twist.text: Reverse logistics is expensive and complex. Collecting, sorting, and processing returns costs more than disposal.

climax.text: As raw material prices rise and regulations tighten, the economics of recovery are improving rapidly.

punchline.text: Yesterday's waste is tomorrow's raw material.

quiz.question: What does Apple's robot Daisy do?
options: Disassembles old iPhones to recover valuable materials
